ageHint: Accounts are for people 13 and over.
errorUnderMinAge: You need to be 13 or older to make an account. Ask a grown-up — everything here works without one.
googleStepIntro: Check your name and add your age to finish.
signInIntro: Sign in with Google or your email. Every lesson still works without an account.
signUpMetaTitle: Create an account · Science Behind It
signUpIntro: Optional, for people 13 and over. Every lesson works without one.
signUpPasswordHint: At least 10 characters. A short phrase is easy to remember.
signUpFineprint: We keep your name, email and age to run your account, and nothing else.
forgotMetaTitle: Forgot your password · Science Behind It
forgotIntro: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new one.
forgotSent: If that email has an account, we have sent it a link to choose a new password. The link works for 1 hour.
resetMetaTitle: Choose a new password · Science Behind It
resetIntro: This signs you out on every other device.
resetDone: Your password is changed, and every device was signed out.
verifyMetaTitle: Confirm your email · Science Behind It
deletedIntro: Your details, saved lessons and linked photos are gone. Copies in our backups are gone within 30 days.
deletedText: Every lesson still works without an account.
accountConfirmEmail: Please confirm your email. We sent a link to {email}.
accountLinkedText: This device is linked. The photos you kept here are tied to your account, not just to this browser.
accountLinkOffNone: Off. Linking ties the photos you kept on this device to your account, so clearing this browser does not leave them behind. You can unlink at any time.
accountLinkOffOne: Off. Linking ties the photo you kept on this device (1) to your account, so clearing this browser does not leave it behind. You can unlink at any time.
accountLinkOffOther: Off. Linking ties the photos you kept on this device ({count}) to your account, so clearing this browser does not leave them behind. You can unlink at any time.
dataIntro: Download a copy of everything tied to your account: your details, saved lessons and the photos linked to it.
dataSaved: Your data was saved as a file.
dataDeleteWarning: This deletes your account, your saved lessons, and the photos linked to it, straight away. It cannot be undone. Copies in our backups are gone within 30 days.
dataConfirmMismatch: Type the email of this account exactly, to confirm.
savedLead: Each one is kept exactly as you saved it. Only you can see this list.
